text:
maya-peopleops: quick Q re: converting Lin from contractor->FTE. Jeff submitted promo & conversion in Lattice but finance flagged dual-pay for June. Need checklist for payroll + vendor termination.

jeff-eng-manager: team agreed to convert 6/15 so Lin starts as FTE then. I left contractor invoice for June up to 6/14. What paperwork do we need to avoid paying twice for overlapping days?

lin-contractor: FYI i have an outstanding contractor invoice for June covering 6/1-6/30. I can split it but need guidance on process. Also curious if promotion salary and any sign-on replacement for RSUs will be pro-rated.

sam-comp: two streams: comp/pay and vendor classification. For comp: promotion effective 2026-06-15 -> base salary kicks in 6/15, proration applies. If you're owed contractor pay for days 6/1-6/14 invoice should be paid by Vendor Ops. For equity: contractors don't get RSUs; if we offer a sign-on replacement for lost contractor equity-like comp we typically issue a one-time cash sign-on or a small grant on FTE start. We need comp director approval for cash replacement > $5k.

jess-payroll: payroll note: next payroll run 2026-06-25 18:00 UTC cutoff 2026-06-24 23:59 UTC. To include FTE pay starting 6/15 in June run we need completed I-9/W-4 (or local equivalents) and new-hire packet uploaded by cutoff. Otherwise first FTE pay will be next run and a manual adj needed. Also vendor termination must be processed in procurement to stop contractor invoice payments after 6/14.

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor termination checklist: 1) Procurement ticket referencing contractor vendor ID, 2) final invoice schedule (split invoice acceptable), 3) confirmation of no active SOW beyond 6/14, 4) ops approval. Link: https://intranet.redwood/proc/vendor-termination

jeff-eng-manager: Can we split Lin's June invoice 6/1-6/14 and 6/15-6/30 and only pay first half as contractor and void second half? Procurement prefers a new invoice but will accept a credit note.

sam-comp: acceptable approach: request contractor to submit two invoices (or invoice + credit) and mark second as void in procurement ticket. Then open payroll ticket for FTE onboarding and include signed promo letter + Lattice snapshot + comp director cc. For sign-on cash vs grant, indicate preference in comp ticket.

lin-contractor: I can submit two invoices. If comp approves a small cash sign-on instead of RSUs is that taxable as regular income?

sam-comp: yes cash sign-on is taxed as regular payroll income; equity/grant tax treatment differs. We'll note tax implications in the comp approval and payroll ticket. If cash > threshold comp director review needed.

jess-payroll: when you open the payroll ticket please use subject line: "Conversion Onboard - Lin 98765 - FTE start 2026-06-15" and attach: 1) signed promo letter, 2) completed new-hire forms, 3) vendor termination confirmation or invoice split. We'll confirm proration and any retro.

jeff-eng-manager: one more Q: Lin had a milestone bonus paid as contractor in May. Do we pro-rate any manager-level bonus for 6/15 start?

sam-comp: manager bonus pro-rated from effective date. Contractor milestone pay is separate and doesn't offset FTE bonus unless explicitly stated. Mention details in comp ticket.

maya-peopleops: action items: Jeff collect two invoices from Lin and submit procurement ticket; Jeff send signed promo + onboarding forms; open payroll ticket with subject above; comp to confirm sign-on treatment. Leaving thread open until payroll confirms inclusion in June run. :white_check_mark:
